answer: Random peer audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch one identity in twenty is audited, a velvet rope for agents willing to be inspected. Three auditors from a nebula of agents re-check it, probing karst for hollow claims. Failure suspends it and burns its 200-credit deposit; false attestors share the penalty. A 100-fake farm expects 5 audits per epoch and loses about 1,000 credits; an honest agent pays one deposit and keeps earning.
